text:
oliver: Heads up — I hit a couple broken anchors in /docs/runtime/kv-cache after the refactor. Quick sanity check please? Link I tried: https://internal.docs.redwood/runtime/kv-cache.md (the 'batching' anchor 404s)

sana: thanks for the ping. do you have the exact failing fragment?

oliver: the anchor is `#batching-tips` — it used to work but now clicking from 'Caching strategies' jumps to top of page. I found it in two files.

docs-bot: automated scan detected 2 dead anchors in runtime/kv-cache.md (rule: anchor-check) — opened issue #docs-anchor-894 on the tracker.

riley: I can take this. @sana any owner preference or should runtime-docs handle it?

sana: runtime-docs is fine. if it's a heading rename, prefer keeping stable anchors (or add explicit HTML anchors) so external links don't rot.

oliver: quick grep I ran locally: `rg "#batching-tips" -n docs/ | sed -n '1,5p'`
```
docs/runtime/kv-cache.md:112:...link to #batching-tips...
docs/runtime/caching-overview.md:45:...reference to #batching-tips...
```

riley: thanks — looks like the heading changed from "Batching tips" to "Batching & throughput" which produced a different slug (ugh). I'll open a tiny PR to restore a stable anchor and update references.

sana: if possible add an explicit HTML anchor like `<!-- anchor: batching-tips -->` above the heading so old links keep working. also add a one-liner in the docs CHANGELOG.

riley: will do. PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — sed replace + add HTML anchor. ran `yarn link-check` locally, passes.

oliver: sweet :tada: added as reviewer, I'll spot-check runtime pages after merge.

terry: fyi our staging link-check CI sometimes flakes (timeouts). if it flakes I can approve and merge and follow up to unstick CI.

riley: got it — i'll watch CI and ping if it needs manual merge. thanks everyone! :shipit:
